requirement_text.REQ-044: Port the core value types and top-level dispatch of src/engine/transition.zig's transition() (per src/design/engine.md "Section EE-02: Pure Transition Function", L442) as a pure Letflow module -- no Ecto.Repo call, no I/O of any kind, no clock read, matching transition.zig's own header contract ("All state is passed in; all output is returned. No DB, no network, no clock") and the same purity bar REQ-028 already established for the graph validator. This requirement builds the SKELETON and its non-gateway node transitions only. The gateway bodies are separate requirements (REQ-050 exclusive, REQ-051 parallel split/join) that plug into the dispatch this requirement defines -- transition.zig is 3323 lines and cannot be one agent turn. Port: - InstanceState (engine.md section EE-02 1): instance_id, status (ACTIVE/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/ERROR, reusing REQ-043's Ecto.Enum values), tokens, variables (a plain Elixir map). - Token (engine.md section EE-02 2): node_id, branch_id, token_id, waiting_child_instance_id. - TransitionEvent and PendingEvent as tagged tuples or structs. - transition/3: (definition_snapshot, instance_state, event) -> {:ok, new_instance_state, pending_events} | {:error, reason}. Determinism is load-bearing. An unknown event type returns an error state, never raises. A token sitting on a node id absent from the snapshot graph returns an error state naming the inconsistency. Non-gateway node transitions: HUMAN_TASK appends to pending_task_nodes; END moves the instance toward COMPLETED. Reuses REQ-028's DefinitionGraph/GraphNode/GraphEdge/NodeType structs directly (lib/letflow/definitions/graph.ex). REQ-044's depends_on in docs/requirements.yaml is [REQ-028, REQ-029] (both done) -- NOT REQ-043 (still pending). Since this module is pure (zero Ecto.Repo calls), it must not reference any REQ-043 schema module that doesn't exist yet; it only needs status atoms source-compatible with REQ-043's future Ecto.Enum.
